title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗~Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing
focus: 以設計風速、相似律、節段與全橋模型試驗，確認長跨橋梁在渦振、馳振與顫振前保有足夠風速餘裕~Design wind speed, similitude and section and full-bridge model tests that confirm long-span bridges keep enough margin against vortex shedding, galloping and flutter
summary: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。~Starting from the torsional flutter collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, establish deck design wind speed, the classes of aeroelastic phenomena, section shape and torsional stiffness and structural parameters such as the Scruton number, then cover wind resistance during cantilever erection, spring-mounted section-model tests and scaling, full aeroelastic models, in-service vortex vibration and damper retrofits and aerodynamic rechecks before modifications, using the full-model wind-tunnel tests of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge.

units.anchor: 橋面高度設計風速~Deck-level design wind speed
units.title: 設計風速與風場特性~Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics
units.mechanism: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。~The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence. Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests.
units.model: 冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。~Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。~Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
units.failure: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。~Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment.
units.misconception: 橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。~A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.
units.practice: 風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。~The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.

units.anchor: 渦振臨界風速 U_cr~Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr
units.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振~Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting
units.mechanism: 風對長跨橋面造成四類動力問題：渦流脫落在特定風速鎖定結構頻率，引起有限振幅的渦振，常在低風速出現而影響舒適與疲勞；馳振是鈍形斷面在單一方向的自激振動，振幅隨風速無限增長；顫振是彎曲與扭轉耦合（或純扭轉）的自激振動，一旦超過臨界風速，氣動力持續輸入能量而發散；抖振則是紊流造成的隨機強迫振動，不會發散但控制強度與疲勞。風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。~Wind causes four classes of dynamic problems on long-span decks: vortex shedding locks onto a structural frequency at particular speeds and causes limited-amplitude vortex-induced vibration, often at low speed and affecting comfort and fatigue; galloping is a single-direction self-excited motion of bluff sections whose amplitude grows without limit with speed; flutter is self-excited coupled bending–torsion or pure torsion that diverges beyond a critical speed as the airflow keeps feeding energy; buffeting is random forced vibration from turbulence that does not diverge but governs strength and fatigue. Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response.
units.model: 渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。梁深 D = 4 m、豎向頻率 f = 0.15 Hz、St = 0.10：U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s，屬常見風速，振動會頻繁發生；若改為 St = 0.20 的較流線斷面，U_cr 降為 3.0 m/s，但能量通常較小。數值為教學假設。~Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。~In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case.
units.failure: 1940 年 11 月 7 日，主跨約 853 m、以 8 呎深板梁為加勁梁的塔科馬海峽橋，在約 40 mph（64 km/h）的風中發生扭轉振動，振幅不斷增大直到吊索斷裂、橋面墜落；這不是靜力風壓過大，而是氣動自激振動。~On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure.
units.misconception: 只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。~If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
units.practice: 設計審查要求風工程報告分別列出渦振、馳振、顫振的檢核結果與抖振反應，並說明每一項採用的允收準則；任何一項無法以計算確認時，必須以風洞試驗驗證。~Design review requires the wind report to list results for vortex shedding, galloping and flutter and the buffeting response separately, with the acceptance criterion for each; any item that cannot be confirmed by calculation must be verified by wind-tunnel test.

units.anchor: 斷面外形與扭轉常數 J~Section shape and torsion constant J
units.title: 橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度~Deck section shape and torsional stiffness
units.mechanism: 橋面斷面決定了氣流如何分離與再附著：寬而淺、兩端尖削的流線箱梁能讓氣流平順通過，顫振臨界風速高；開口板梁或鈍形斷面則在前緣強烈分離，容易產生渦流與扭轉自激。塔科馬海峽橋寬約 39 呎、梁深 8 呎，寬深比低又是開口斷面，扭轉勁度極小。改善方法包括閉合箱梁、加導流板（整流罩）、中央開槽或格柵，以及加深的桁架加勁梁；閉合斷面的扭轉勁度遠高於開口斷面，使扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率分開，提升顫振風速。~The deck section governs how flow separates and reattaches: a wide, shallow streamlined box with tapered edges lets air pass smoothly and has a high flutter speed, while an open plate-girder or bluff section separates strongly at the leading edge and readily sheds vortices and self-excites in torsion. The Tacoma Narrows deck was about 39 ft wide and 8 ft deep, a low width-to-depth ratio on an open section with tiny torsional stiffness. Remedies include closed boxes, fairings, central slots or gratings and deeper truss stiffening girders; a closed section is far stiffer in torsion than an open one, separating torsional from bending frequency and raising flutter speed.
units.model: 閉合箱梁 J = 4A²/∮(ds/t)：30 m×3 m、等效板厚 14 mm，A = 90 m²，∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714，J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴；同尺寸開口雙板梁 J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴，約小 158,000 倍。數值為教學假設。~Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以有限元素模型計算扭轉與彎曲頻率比，並在概念階段以多個候選斷面做快速節段模型試驗或計算流體力學比較，選出氣動性能最佳者；確定斷面後，連同欄杆、防風牆、檢修車軌道等附屬物的實際外形一起試驗。~Compute the torsion-to-bending frequency ratio with a finite-element model, compare several candidate sections at concept stage by quick section-model tests or computational fluid dynamics to choose the best aerodynamic form, and once the section is fixed, test it with the real geometry of railings, wind screens and inspection-gantry rails.
units.failure: 設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。~Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test; small attachments can decide where flow separates.
units.misconception: 橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。~The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder.
units.practice: 風洞模型必須包含欄杆、防風牆、排水溝、檢修車軌道等外露附屬物的正確幾何；設計凍結後，任何改變外形的變更都要經風工程師書面評估，必要時重新試驗。~Wind-tunnel models must include the correct geometry of railings, wind screens, gutters and gantry rails; after design freeze, any change to the external shape requires the wind engineer's written assessment and, if needed, retesting.

units.anchor: 質量阻尼參數 Sc~Scruton number Sc
units.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數~Mass, damping and the Scruton number
units.mechanism: 同一個斷面外形，振動大小還取決於結構本身的質量與阻尼：每延公尺質量越大、阻尼越高，風輸入的能量越難把結構推動。Scruton 數把質量、對數衰減率與空氣密度、斷面深度合成一個無因次參數，渦振振幅大致隨 Scruton 數增加而減小。鋼橋的結構阻尼通常很低，混凝土橋較高；施工中或完工後的實際阻尼常與設計假設不同，因此試驗時要以合理偏低的阻尼檢核，並在完工後實測。~For a given section shape, response size also depends on the structure's mass and damping: the greater the mass per metre and the higher the damping, the harder it is for wind energy to drive the structure. The Scruton number combines mass, logarithmic decrement, air density and section depth into one dimensionless parameter, and vortex amplitude falls roughly as it rises. Steel bridges usually have very low structural damping and concrete bridges more; actual damping during and after construction often differs from design assumptions, so tests use a reasonably low damping value and damping is measured after completion.
units.model: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。m = 20,000 kg/m、δ = 0.03、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³、D = 4 m：Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60；若實際對數衰減率只有 0.015，Sc 降為 30，渦振振幅約加倍。數值為教學假設。~Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²). With m = 20,000 kg/m, δ = 0.03, ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ and D = 4 m: Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60; if the actual logarithmic decrement is only 0.015, Sc falls to 30 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）；完工後以環境振動或強迫振動實測橋梁的頻率與阻尼，與試驗假設比較，若阻尼明顯偏低則重新評估渦振振幅。~The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower.
units.failure: 試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。~Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems.
units.misconception: 結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。~Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.
units.practice: 風洞報告要明示試驗採用的阻尼值及其依據，並提供不同阻尼下的振幅敏感度；合約中預留完工後實測阻尼與必要時加裝阻尼器的條款與空間。~The wind report states the damping used and its basis and gives amplitude sensitivity to damping; the contract reserves post-completion damping measurement and the space and provisions to add dampers if needed.

units.anchor: 最大懸臂階段~Longest cantilever stage
units.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定~Aerodynamic stability during erection
units.mechanism: 橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。施工階段的風速檢核可以採用較短的回歸期，但因為頻率降低、阻尼不確定，渦振與顫振的臨界風速可能落入常見範圍。因此風洞試驗必須涵蓋關鍵施工階段，而不只是完工狀態。~Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state; a suspension bridge whose deck segments are being lifted with joints not yet locked has particularly low torsional stiffness. Construction-stage wind checks may use a shorter return period, but with reduced frequencies and uncertain damping the vortex and flutter onset speeds can fall into the common range. Wind-tunnel tests must therefore cover the critical construction stages, not only the completed state.
units.model: 懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。最大懸臂由 150 m 增為 200 m，頻率降為 (150/200)² ≈ 0.56 倍：扭轉頻率 0.60 Hz 降為約 0.34 Hz，渦振臨界風速由 6.0 m/s 降為約 3.4 m/s，顫振風速亦隨扭轉頻率約按比例下降。數值為教學假設。~Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L². Growing the longest cantilever from 150 m to 200 m multiplies frequency by (150/200)² ≈ 0.56: a 0.60 Hz torsional frequency falls to about 0.34 Hz, the vortex onset speed from 6.0 to about 3.4 m/s, and flutter speed drops roughly in proportion to torsional frequency. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。~Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models; the return period and wind speed used must be approved by the owner and compared with typhoon seasons in the construction schedule.
units.failure: 只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。~Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays; if the motion damages lifting equipment or temporary joints, the consequences can exceed anything in service.
units.misconception: 施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。~Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.
units.practice: 施工計畫要列出每個關鍵階段的容許風速、臨時穩定措施與颱風來臨前的固定程序，並經風工程師與設計者確認；最大懸臂階段盡量避開颱風季。~The construction plan lists allowable wind speeds, temporary stabilising measures and pre-typhoon securing procedures for each critical stage, confirmed by the wind engineer and designer; schedule the longest cantilever outside the typhoon season where possible.

units.anchor: 臨時穩定索與吊裝風速~Temporary stays and lifting wind limits
units.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速~Erection-stage wind measures and working limits
units.mechanism: 施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成；作業措施則是以現地風速計即時監控，超過門檻時停止吊裝、鎖固吊具與梁段。懸臂越長，橫向風力在塔或墩底產生的彎矩越大，臨時措施也要能承受颱風等級的風力。~Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational. Structural measures include temporary stays tying the cantilever tip down to the ground or a pier, temporary supports that shorten the cantilever, temporary tuned mass dampers at the tip and erection sequences that build torsional stiffness earlier; operational measures use site anemometers for real-time monitoring, stopping lifts and securing lifting gear and segments above set thresholds. The longer the cantilever, the larger the moment that lateral wind creates at the pylon or pier base, and temporary measures must also resist typhoon-level wind.
units.model: 橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。U = 25 m/s、C_D = 1.2、D = 4 m、L = 200 m：F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN；作用於懸臂中點，塔底附加彎矩 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m；風速加倍為 50 m/s 時增為 4 倍。數值為教學假設。~Lateral wind force F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L. With U = 25 m/s, C_D = 1.2, D = 4 m and L = 200 m: F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN; acting at mid-cantilever it adds 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m at the pylon base, and doubling speed to 50 m/s quadruples it. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風；臨時穩定索的張力以荷重計監測，颱風前後比對；臨時阻尼器安裝後以自由衰減試驗確認懸臂阻尼提升。~Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts; monitor temporary-stay tension with load cells before and after typhoons; after fitting a temporary damper, confirm the cantilever's added damping by a free-decay test.
units.failure: 吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。~Lifting decided only by forecasts, without site anemometers, lets a segment swing in a gust after pick-up and strike completed work; failing to tension temporary stays before a typhoon leaves the cantilever tip vibrating heavily in strong wind, damaging joints and lifting gear.
units.misconception: 懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。~As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
units.practice: 把作業風速門檻、颱風警報下的固定程序與臨時穩定索張拉列為停留點，由施工主管與監造簽認；此處只建立判斷與查驗原則，實際吊裝與張拉作業須由合格人員依核准的施工計畫執行。~Make working wind thresholds, the securing procedure under typhoon warnings and temporary-stay tensioning hold points signed by the site manager and inspector; this step sets out reasoning and checks only, and actual lifting and tensioning must be done by qualified personnel under the approved method statement.

units.anchor: 節段模型速度縮尺~Section-model velocity scale
units.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗~Spring-mounted section-model testing
units.mechanism: 節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。相似的關鍵是折減風速 U/(f·B) 相同，因此可以自由選擇模型頻率，再由頻率比與長度縮尺換算風速縮尺。試驗可直接觀察渦振與顫振，也可量測靜力係數與顫振導數，供全橋顫振與抖振分析使用；塔科馬海峽橋崩塌前，Farquharson 已在華盛頓大學以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型進行研究。~A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype. The key similarity is equal reduced velocity U/(f·B), so the model frequency can be chosen freely and the velocity scale follows from the frequency ratio and length scale. Tests observe vortex shedding and flutter directly and measure static coefficients and flutter derivatives for full-bridge flutter and buffeting analysis; before the Tacoma Narrows collapse, Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model.
units.model: 速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。長度縮尺 1/60，原型寬 35 m 對應模型 0.583 m；原型扭轉頻率 0.30 Hz、模型 2.0 Hz，λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111。模型在 7.0 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s，即折減風速 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0。數值為教學假設。~Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p). At a 1/60 length scale a 35 m prototype width becomes 0.583 m; with prototype torsional frequency 0.30 Hz and model frequency 2.0 Hz, λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111. Flutter at 7.0 m/s in the model corresponds to 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。~Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility.
units.failure: 模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。~Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed.
units.misconception: 縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。~If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed.
units.practice: 試驗計畫要列出長度、頻率、速度、質量與阻尼的縮尺關係與允差，試驗報告附原始資料、攻角與流場條件；顫振檢核以最不利攻角的結果為準，並由獨立風工程師審查。~The test plan lists scale relations and tolerances for length, frequency, velocity, mass and damping, and the report attaches raw data, attack angles and flow conditions; flutter checks use the worst angle, reviewed by an independent wind engineer.

units.anchor: 全橋氣動彈性模型~Full aeroelastic model
units.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場~Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow
units.mechanism: 節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。全橋氣動彈性模型以 Froude 相似律縮放（使重力勁度正確），在大型邊界層風洞中重現紊流風場，直接觀察整座橋在不同風向下的反應。明石海峽大橋（主跨 1,991 m，1988 至 1998 年建造）即以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證其抗風性能，加勁梁設計風速為 60 m/s、橋塔為 67 m/s。~Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence. A full aeroelastic model is scaled by Froude similitude so that gravity stiffness is correct and tested in a large boundary-layer tunnel that reproduces turbulent wind, directly observing the whole bridge's response at different wind directions. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge (main span 1,991 m, built 1988 to 1998) was verified by full-model wind-tunnel testing, with design wind speeds of 60 m/s for the stiffening girder and 67 m/s for the towers.
units.model: Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。λ_L = 1/100 時 λ_U = 0.1：原型 60 m/s 對應模型 6 m/s；原型頻率 0.15 Hz 對應模型 1.5 Hz；模型 1 分鐘記錄相當原型 10 分鐘。數值為教學假設。~Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L. At λ_L = 1/100, λ_U = 0.1: 60 m/s at full scale is 6 m/s in the model, a 0.15 Hz prototype frequency is 1.5 Hz in the model and 1 minute of model record equals 10 minutes at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。~Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained.
units.failure: 全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。~If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong; tunnel turbulence that is too weak underestimates buffeting and leaves tower and girder design moments too low.
units.misconception: 節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。~If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
units.practice: 主跨超過一定規模或形式特殊的橋梁，業主應在設計階段就安排全橋模型試驗的時程與經費；全橋試驗報告要列出模型縮尺、風場量測、各風向的反應與和分析的比較。~For bridges beyond a certain span or of unusual form, the owner schedules and funds full-model testing from the design stage; the report lists model scales, wind-field measurements, responses by wind direction and comparison with analysis.

units.anchor: 營運期渦振與阻尼器~In-service vortex vibration and dampers
units.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善~In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies
units.mechanism: 風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。2010 年 5 月俄羅斯伏爾加格勒大橋在強風中出現明顯振動，當局在 5 月 20 日封閉全部車流、5 月 25 日重新開放，之後由 MAURER 與瑞士 Empa 等合作開發半主動調諧質量阻尼器，於 2011 年秋季安裝 12 組、每組質量 5,200 kg。營運期的改善手段包括加裝阻尼器、導流板或整流罩，以及移除改變氣流的附屬物，但每一項都要先以監測資料確認振動型態。~Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test. In May 2010 the Volgograd Bridge in Russia vibrated noticeably in strong wind; authorities closed it to all motor traffic on 20 May and reopened it on 25 May, and semi-active tuned mass dampers were then developed by MAURER with partners including the Swiss laboratory Empa, with 12 units of 5,200 kg each installed in autumn 2011. In-service remedies include added dampers, guide vanes or fairings and removal of attachments that alter the flow, but each must start from monitoring data that confirm the vibration pattern.
units.model: 渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。若加裝阻尼器使對數衰減率由 0.02 提升到 0.08，Sc 增為 4 倍，振幅約降為 1/4，例如由 0.40 m 降為約 0.10 m；12 組 5,200 kg 阻尼器合計質量 62,400 kg。數值除阻尼器規格外為教學假設。~Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc. Raising the logarithmic decrement from 0.02 to 0.08 with dampers quadruples Sc and cuts amplitude to about a quarter, for example from 0.40 m to about 0.10 m; twelve 5,200 kg dampers total 62,400 kg. Values other than the damper data are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。~Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data.
units.failure: 未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。~Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin.
units.misconception: 完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。~A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.
units.practice: 長跨橋梁的監測系統要能在風振事件時自動觸發高頻記錄並通知管理單位；任何改善方案須以監測資料與風洞或數值驗證為依據，並由原設計或獨立風工程師核定。~Monitoring on long-span bridges should automatically trigger high-rate recording and notify the owner during wind-vibration events; any remedy must rest on monitoring data and wind-tunnel or numerical verification, approved by the original designer or an independent wind engineer.

units.anchor: 附屬物變更的氣動複核~Aerodynamic recheck of attachments
units.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接~Change control, closure wind speeds and handover
units.mechanism: 橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。交接文件因此要保存風洞試驗的斷面幾何、試驗條件、靜力係數、顫振導數與允收結果，並規定任何外形變更都需氣動複核。營運面則要訂定依風速分級的交通管制，例如強風時限制高車身車輛或封橋，並把風速監測與管制程序連結。~Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed. Handover documents must therefore keep the tested section geometry, test conditions, static coefficients, flutter derivatives and acceptance results, and require aerodynamic review of any change in shape. Operationally, wind-speed-graded traffic control, such as restricting high-sided vehicles or closing the bridge in strong wind, must be defined and linked to wind monitoring.
units.model: 每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。U = 60 m/s、D = 4 m：無防風牆 C_D = 1.0 時 F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m；加裝防風牆後 C_D = 1.6，F = 14.4 kN/m，1 km 橋長的總橫向風力由 9,000 kN 增為 14,400 kN。數值為教學假設。~Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D. With U = 60 m/s and D = 4 m: without wind screens, C_D = 1.0 gives F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m; with screens C_D = 1.6 gives 14.4 kN/m, raising the total lateral load on 1 km of deck from 9,000 kN to 14,400 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。~Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically.
units.failure: 管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。~An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged.
units.misconception: 加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。~Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含風場參數、節段與全橋試驗報告、靜力係數與顫振導數、完工實測頻率與阻尼、監測系統設定與依風速分級的交通管制程序；外形變更一律經風工程師核定後才可施作。~Handover includes wind-field parameters, section and full-model test reports, static coefficients and flutter derivatives, measured as-built frequencies and damping, monitoring settings and wind-graded traffic-control procedures; any change of shape proceeds only after a wind engineer's approval.

example: 設計練習：某斜張橋主梁寬 B = 32 m、深 D = 3.5 m，扭轉頻率 f_t = 0.35 Hz、豎向頻率 f_b = 0.12 Hz、每延公尺質量 18,000 kg/m、對數衰減率 0.03。基本風速 40 m/s、橋面高 70 m，取 α = 0.125：U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s，顫振需求取 1.2 倍約 61.2 m/s。1/50 節段模型、頻率比 f_m/f_p = 5，速度縮尺 (1/50)×5 = 0.1。原斷面在模型 5.6 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 56 m/s，折減風速 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0，小於 61.2 m/s，不合格；加裝整流罩後折減風速提升到 6.5，原型顫振風速 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s，滿足需求。渦振方面，St = 0.11 時豎向渦振臨界風速 U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s，Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5；若完工實測阻尼只有一半，Sc 約 35，渦振振幅約加倍，需預留阻尼器空間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的試驗結果。~Design exercise: a cable-stayed girder is B = 32 m wide and D = 3.5 m deep, with torsional frequency f_t = 0.35 Hz, vertical frequency f_b = 0.12 Hz, 18,000 kg/m mass and a logarithmic decrement of 0.03. With a 40 m/s basic speed, a 70 m deck height and α = 0.125, U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s, and the flutter requirement at 1.2 times is about 61.2 m/s. A 1/50 section model with frequency ratio f_m/f_p = 5 has velocity scale (1/50)×5 = 0.1. The original section flutters at 5.6 m/s in the model, 56 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0, below 61.2 m/s, so it fails; adding fairings raises the reduced velocity to 6.5, giving a full-scale flutter speed of 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s, which meets the requirement. For vortex shedding with St = 0.11 the vertical onset speed is U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s and Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5; if as-built damping is only half, Sc is about 35 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles, so space for dampers should be reserved. Values are teaching assumptions, not test results for any real bridge.
history: 1940 年 7 月 1 日通車的塔科馬海峽橋，以 8 呎深板梁加勁約 853 m 的主跨，同年 11 月 7 日在約 40 mph 的風中扭轉振動崩塌；華盛頓大學 Farquharson 當時已以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型研究其振動，並建議導流措施，但未及實施。由 Ammann、von Kármán 與 Woodruff 組成的委員會調查後，氣動力在橋梁設計中的地位大幅提升，風洞試驗逐漸成為長跨橋梁的必要程序，1950 年 10 月 14 日新橋通車；1970 年代 Scanlan 等人提出以顫振導數描述橋面自激氣動力。1998 年完工的明石海峽大橋以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證抗風設計，2010 年伏爾加格勒大橋的振動事件則提醒完工後仍需監測與改善。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的試驗或設計文件。~The Tacoma Narrows Bridge, opened on 1 July 1940 with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted itself apart in a wind of about 40 mph on 7 November that year; Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying its motion with a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model and had recommended aerodynamic fixes that were never installed. After the board of Ammann, von Kármán and Woodruff investigated, aerodynamics gained a central place in bridge design and wind-tunnel testing became a standard step for long spans; the replacement bridge opened on 14 October 1950, and in the 1970s Scanlan and others introduced flutter derivatives to describe self-excited deck forces. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge, completed in 1998, verified its wind design with full-model wind-tunnel testing, while the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge showed that monitoring and remedies are still needed after completion. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's test or design documents.
facts: 塔科馬海峽橋 1940 年 7 月 1 日通車、11 月 7 日崩塌，主跨約 853 m（2,800 ft）~The Tacoma Narrows Bridge opened on 1 July 1940 and collapsed on 7 November 1940, with a main span of about 853 m (2,800 ft)
塔科馬海峽橋以 8 呎深板梁加勁，橋面寬約 39 呎，崩塌時風速約 40 mph~Tacoma Narrows was stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders on a deck about 39 ft wide and fell in a wind of about 40 mph
Farquharson 以 1/200 全橋模型與 1/20 節段模型研究塔科馬海峽橋振動~Farquharson studied the Tacoma Narrows motion with a 1:200 full model and a 1:20 section model
塔科馬海峽替代橋於 1950 年 10 月 14 日通車，施工 29 個月~The replacement Tacoma Narrows Bridge opened on 14 October 1950 after 29 months of construction
明石海峽大橋主跨 1,991 m、全長 3,911 m，1988 年 5 月至 1998 年 4 月建造~The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge has a 1,991 m main span and 3,911 m total length, built from May 1988 to April 1998
明石海峽大橋基本風速 46 m/s，加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s、橋塔 67 m/s~The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge uses a 46 m/s basic wind speed, with design speeds of 60 m/s for the girder and 67 m/s for the towers
伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年 5 月 20 日因強風振動封閉，5 月 25 日重新開放~The Volgograd Bridge was closed for wind-induced oscillation on 20 May 2010 and reopened on 25 May
伏爾加格勒大橋 2011 年秋季安裝 12 組、每組 5,200 kg 的半主動調諧質量阻尼器~Twelve semi-active tuned mass dampers of 5,200 kg each were installed on the Volgograd Bridge in autumn 2011
節段模型常用長度縮尺約 1/40 至 1/80，全橋氣動彈性模型常依 Froude 相似律縮放~Section models commonly use length scales of about 1/40 to 1/80, and full aeroelastic models are usually scaled by Froude similitude

timeline.event: 塔科馬海峽橋 7 月通車、11 月在約 40 mph 風中扭轉振動崩塌~The Tacoma Narrows Bridge opens in July and collapses in torsional motion in a wind of about 40 mph in November
塔科馬海峽替代橋通車，風洞試驗成為長跨橋梁設計的標準程序~The replacement Tacoma Narrows Bridge opens as wind-tunnel testing becomes standard for long spans
Scanlan 與 Tomko 提出以顫振導數描述橋面自激氣動力~Scanlan and Tomko introduce flutter derivatives to describe self-excited forces on bridge decks
以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證抗風設計的明石海峽大橋完工~The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge, whose wind design was verified by full-model wind-tunnel tests, is completed
伏爾加格勒大橋因強風振動封橋，其後加裝 12 組半主動調諧質量阻尼器~The Volgograd Bridge closes after wind-induced oscillation, then receives 12 semi-active tuned mass dampers

日本道路協會道路橋耐風設計便覽~Japan Road Association Wind-Resistant Design Manual for Highway Bridges
交通部公路橋梁耐風設計規範~Taiwan Wind-Resistant Design Specifications for Highway Bridges (MOTC)
ASCE/SEI 49：建築物與其他結構物風洞試驗~ASCE/SEI 49: Wind Tunnel Testing for Buildings and Other Structures
